chunks.text: The Execution Gate requires planning state, readiness scoring, mode selection, approval lock, and run trace before execution.
Source lineage preserves source IDs, chunk IDs, file hashes, parser warnings, and cited evidence for every answer trace.
The desktop launcher builds the frontend, starts the backend, checks the health endpoint, stops the process, and confirms the port closes.
CSV ingestion records delimiter, headers, duplicate header warnings, row count, truncation status, and parser metadata.
Mock mode is the deterministic default. Anthropic live mode requires explicit opt in, API key configuration, and provider readiness.
Directory ingestion is permission gated. External paths require an explicit directory grant before ingest-path reads a file or folder.
Persistent retrieval uses a local TF-IDF index under data indexes, rebuilds during ingestion, and fails closed when the chunk fingerprint is stale.
Chat sessions persist conversation turns, include prior user and assistant turns as bounded context, and store answer traces for follow-up questions.
The local operator auth boundary is optional. When MUCARO_AI_OPERATOR_TOKEN is set, mutating API routes require a bearer or X-Mucaro-Token header.
Runtime status panels show backend health, provider name, upload progress, and frontend build status for normal local operations.
